headline.en: No in-unit safety service on this flat
headline.zh-Hant: 此單位未安裝室內安全服務

detail.en: This flat has no PEMO-connected sensors, so there is nothing to report here. You will still receive building safety notices from the management office.
detail.zh-Hant: 此單位沒有連接PEMO的感應器，因此沒有狀態可報告。您仍會收到管理處的大廈安全通告。

disclaimer.en: PEMO notifications supplement the building fire alarm and statutory emergency procedures. They do not replace them.
disclaimer.zh-Hant: 此通知為輔助性質，不能取代大廈火警系統及法定緊急程序。

installedServicesNote.en: Nothing installed. This screen never implies the flat is monitored.
installedServicesNote.zh-Hant: 未有安裝。此畫面不表示此單位受到監察。
